File Structure

Mini Programs are divided into app and page. The app describes the entire application, the page describes each page, and the configuration description of the entire project (optional).

The app consists of three files that must be placed in the root directory of the project.

File Mandatory or Not Function
app.js Yes Mini Program logic
app.json Yes Mini Program global settings
app.mass No Mini Program global stylesheet

The page consists of four files:

File Type Mandatory or Not Function
js Yes Page Logic
maml Yes Page Structure
mass No Page Style Sheet
json No Page settings

| Note: For the convenience of developers, the apple Mini Program specifies that the four files must have the same path and file name.

Files allowed to be packaged

In the project directory, the following files are compiled and cannot be directly accessed after being packaged: .js, app.json, _.maml, _.mass, *.sk, and *.sjs. In addition, only files with suffix names in the trustlist can be packaged into small packages. The trustlist is as follows:

File Format Description
html html page
js javascript resource file
json json configuration file
css page style file
png Lossless compressed picture file
jpg Lossy compressed picture file
gif dynamic image file
ttf Universal font file
woff web font files
eot Embedded font file
ico icon file
txt text
mp3 Universal compressed audio file
ogg lossy compressed audio file
wav lossless audio file
md markdown file
mp4 video file
xml xml configuration file
fetch Macle data prefetch configuration file

MAML

The MAML is a set of tag language for framework design. It combines basic components and event systems to construct the page structure.

MASS

The MAML style sheets are a set of style languages used to describe the MAML component styles.

SJS

SJS (safe/subset javascript) is a custom scripting language for Mini Program that you can use in MAML to build page structures.
